mapper.select: select b.id, b.bed_id, b.user_id, b.unbound_at from sensor_device_bindings b join users u on u.id = b.user_id where b.sensor_id = #{sensorId} and b.bound_at <= #{startedAt} and (b.unbound_at is null or b.unbound_at >= #{endedAt}) order by b.bound_at desc limit 2
mapper.update: update sensor_workout_sessions set status = 'COMPLETED', training_state = 'idle', ended_at = last_motion_at, end_reason = #{reason} where sensor_id = #{sensorId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and (device_session_id is null or device_session_id <> #{sessionId})
mapper.insert: insert into sensor_boots (sensor_id, boot_id, first_seen_at) values (#{sensorId}, #{bootId}, #{firstSeenAt})

insert into sensor_workout_sessions ( sensor_id, bed_id, user_id, binding_id, boot_id, schema_version, device_session_id, started_at, last_motion_at, start_count, end_count, active_duration_ms, training_state, time_valid, time_quality, ownership_status, start_uptime_ms, end_uptime_ms, average_period_ms, min_period_ms, max_period_ms, last_received_at ) values ( #{sensorId}, #{ownership.bedId}, #{ownership.userId}, #{ownership.bindingId}, #{telemetry.bootId}, 4, #{telemetry.sessionId}, #{startedAt}, #{lastMotionAt}, 0, #{telemetry.sessionRepetitionCount}, #{telemetry.activeDurationMs}, #{trainingState}, #{telemetry.timeValid}, #{timeQuality}, #{ownership.status}, #{telemetry.startUptimeMs}, #{telemetry.endUptimeMs}, #{telemetry.averagePeriodMs}, #{telemetry.minPeriodMs}, #{telemetry.maxPeriodMs}, #{receivedAt} )
mapper.update: update sensor_workout_sessions set bed_id = #{ownership.bedId}, user_id = #{ownership.userId}, binding_id = #{ownership.bindingId}, started_at = #{startedAt}, last_motion_at = #{lastMotionAt}, end_count = #{telemetry.sessionRepetitionCount}, active_duration_ms = #{telemetry.activeDurationMs}, training_state = #{trainingState}, time_valid = #{telemetry.timeValid}, time_quality = #{timeQuality}, ownership_status = #{ownership.status}, start_uptime_ms = #{telemetry.startUptimeMs}, end_uptime_ms = #{telemetry.endUptimeMs}, average_period_ms = #{telemetry.averagePeriodMs}, min_period_ms = #{telemetry.minPeriodMs}, max_period_ms = #{telemetry.maxPeriodMs}, last_received_at = #{receivedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into sensor_latest_readings ( sensor_id, boot_id, sequence_number, repetition_count, moving, standby, sensor_ok, payload_json, received_at, schema_version, training_state ) values ( #{sensorId}, #{telemetry.bootId}, #{telemetry.sequence}, #{telemetry.repetitionCount}, #{telemetry.moving}, #{telemetry.standby}, #{telemetry.sensorOk}, #{payloadJson}, #{receivedAt}, 4, #{telemetry.trainingState} ) on duplicate key update boot_id = values(boot_id), sequence_number = values(sequence_number), repetition_count = values(repetition_count), moving = values(moving), standby = values(standby), sensor_ok = values(sensor_ok), payload_json = values(payload_json), received_at = values(received_at), schema_version = 4, training_state = values(training_state)
